competitors.name: The 7 Virtues
competitors.why_competitor: Canadian vanilla/gourmand house with a long-lasting promise, CAD pricing and Sephora Canada distribution
competitors.current_offer: 20% off sitewide until December 3 (Vanilla Woods 50ml CA$101.60); 10% off first order for email sign-up; free rollerball with CA$70+ after quiz
strengths: Sephora Canada distribution (per brand's TikTok bio)
Full ladder: CA$7 sample, CA$43.50 10ml, discovery sets, 50ml
weaknesses: 50ml only at CA$2.54/ml, over twice Beguile's per-ml price
Conflicting returns statements (policy: no returns; product page: 30-day returns)

competitors.name: Kayali
competitors.why_competitor: Dubai-made vanilla, musk and oud gourmands in Beguile's scent territory, with a CAD store and mass awareness
competitors.current_offer: Up to 30% off ('The more you spend, the more you save'); extra 10% for subscribing; free sample with all orders; free delivery from CA$142
strengths: Size ladder from CA$5 sample to CA$203 100ml
weaknesses: Canadian delivery times and returns not found

competitors.name: Paraphrase Perfume (formerly Libertine Fragrance)
competitors.why_competitor: Best-known Canadian independent niche house; the local indie alternative at a premium
competitors.current_offer: 11.1% off first order for email sign-up; free shipping over $150; no Black Friday banner seen
strengths: CAD pricing, ships from Ontario in 2-3 business days
Samples CA$11 and discovery sets CA$55-82.50
weaknesses: Most expensive in set: CA$3.94/ml at 50ml

competitors.name: Foope
competitors.origin: Founded in Toronto, Canada; now based in New Jersey, USA; Canadian-Nigerian co-founder
competitors.why_competitor: Only fragrance brand found with Nigerian heritage and Toronto roots; Yoruba-named scents at a low ticket
competitors.current_offer: Free shipping over US$75 (not confirmed for Canada); build-your-own bundle US$117 for four; no Black Friday promotion visible
strengths: Diaspora founder story and Yoruba scent names
Scent quiz and US$38 discovery set
weaknesses: Operations moved to the US; ships from New Jersey
Very small social following, old reviews
